content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day. That's the range the research supports for muscle gain. For example, an 80 kg lifter would eat roughly 130–175 g. 💪

Spread it over 3–5 meals, with about 0.3–0.4 g/kg per meal. Hitting your daily total matters far more than exact timing. Pair it with a slight calorie surplus and consistent training, and your 100 kg bench goal gets a lot closer. Ain't nothin' but a peanut!
